about.title: CSBC China Southern Brony Carnival
about.desc:
We are CSBC, founded in Guangzhou. Since 2022, we have successfully held multiple conventions in the southern region of China.
We are committed to working with Bronies to think together, innovate together, and progress together in the process of development, bringing you a better convention experience.

venue.name: Swissôtel Guangzhou
venue.subtitle: 1961 Huaguan Road (Huanguan Lu), Tianhe District, Guangzhou
venue.desc:
Swissôtel Guangzhou is located in the Software Park, central to Tianhe Intelligence City(IBD).
The hotel has 364 rooms with a modern Oriental style. With All-day dining , Chinese and Japanese Restaurant.Moreover, it has an outdoor swimming pool, a well-equipped fitness center and a 15,000sqm outdoor garden. At Swissôtel, we want you to live life well by encouraging you to live in the moment.

faq.q: Is there any difference in the activity on the 18th/19th?
faq.a:
Yeeeeeeeeeeeeeep!
The events on the 18th and 19th are not the same, please enjoy them!

faq.q: How to receive my con pass and stuff?
faq.a:
They will be granted at the venue on convention days.
Please show the order to our staffs to get your pass and rewards.

faq.q: Are there any entry and exit restrictions during the convention?
faq.a:
There are no restrictions. Attendees can freely enter and exit the venue with their pass during the convention.
The pass is included in your rewards. This is the only proof of entry, please do not lose it.

faq.q: Is there a separate official hotel available for booking?
faq.a:
The hotel room is not only available in Hotel Pack.
You can also make a separate reservation by asking staffs.

faq.q: Is there a limit on the number of tickets?
faq.a:
The total number of our ticket is currently not limited. Different types of tickets have limitations and different quantities.
For more information, please follow our offical updates.

navPage.intro: 2026 CSBC Southern China Brony Carnival (July 18-19) will be held at Guangzhou Swissotel, located at No. 1961 Huaguan Road, Tianhe District, Guangzhou City, Guangdong Province. For attendees heading to the venue, please get off at Tianhe Smart City Station on Guangzhou Metro Line 21. During operating hours, you can take the Brony Bus. It is approximately 1.1 km (about a 17-minute walk) from the metro station to the venue. Alternatively, you may take Bus B26 or Bus 491 for one stop to reduce walking distance.
